activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed
Cleaning up the breakfast dishes and brewing a cup of tea
Setting up the home workspace, checking email and reviewing the day's community program schedule (no commute because of the public transport strike)
Working on community program coordination, answering calls and holding video meetings with partner organizations
Continuing work: planning upcoming community events, updating participant records and drafting grant notes
Vacuuming and tidying the living room after the working day
Changing into comfortable clothes and resting
Relaxing: watching TV and playing a game on the console
Showering and getting ready for bed
Winding down, reading on the phone and setting an alarm
